rheinfall.name: Rhine Falls
rheinfall.slogan: Europe's mightiest waterfall, thundering 23 metres right beside the path.
rheinfall.line: Hold your heart, oh traveller, tightly in mighty hands!

zhgrossmuenster.name: Grossmünster
zhgrossmuenster.slogan: Two bare towers where Zwingli turned Zurich upside down.
zhgrossmuenster.line: Richard Wagner reportedly mocked its twin towers as looking like two pepper dispensers.

zhfraumuenster.name: Fraumünster
zhfraumuenster.slogan: Chagall's blue and gold light, poured over an abbess's old church.
zhfraumuenster.line: In 1045 its abbess won the right to mint coins and hold markets, making her ruler of the city.

steinrathausplatz.name: Stein am Rhein
steinrathausplatz.slogan: Painted facades and oriel windows around a perfect little square.
steinrathausplatz.line: In 1972 Stein am Rhein received the very first Wakker Prize for preserving its architecture.

habsburgcastle.name: Habsburg Castle
habsburgcastle.slogan: A modest hilltop keep where an empire's family name began.
habsburgcastle.line: Built around 1020, it may be named after a hawk (Habicht) that Count Radbot saw on its walls.
